whenToUse: A live countdown to a service-level deadline such as first response or delivery window.
Ticket and order lists that must show at-risk and breached states.
avoidWhen: A neutral elapsed timer for work logging — use time-tracker.
Static due dates — use a formatted date in description-list.
a11y: Uses role="timer" with a full-sentence aria-label for screen readers; state is shown in text as well as colour.
